body: LEAD DISPOSITION: ACCEPT the replay-derived P1 DAG audit. The integration record must carry authority and exact landed evidence per edge; bead status, assignee, handoff prose, a protected candidate, or a measured probe count is not readiness. V2 is therefore refined to seven explicit edges: owner-only human-recall/REB disposition; landed NFRD intake and frozen split; landed provider contract followed separately by a landed real provider with coverage/abstention receipts; landed transition-missingness repair; a newly owned predeclared calibration/refusal court; repaired eligible-term support carrier bound to actual scored coordinates; and chief-owned unforgeable result-receipt acceptance, including the narrower align follow-up where applicable. Current state is uniformly honest: some edges have candidates, some are under repair, some lack an implementation owner, and none may be inferred complete. I will not create or assign the chief-owned P1 integration parent by implication. The original proposal remains needs_bead; chief promotion should create the parent plus any missing child ownership. P1 closes only when the frozen Baseball Diagnostic is actually answered and auditable, including a null or negative result. This does not alter B0 or authorize C1.
